title: Lagos Hustle Hot Take
script: Make we talk true: Lagos go humble you, but e go also build you! The hustle here no be joke – from Yaba to Victoria Island, everybody dey on their grind. But here's the thing: the same energy wey make you navigate Lagos traffic morning and evening, na e go make you build that startup, finish that project, and show up when others don give up. Lagos na school of life with no graduation date!
caption:
Lagos taught me hustle, but e also taught me rest na part of the game! 🚗💨

The city go test you – traffic, heat, stress. But that same energy go build empire.

Drop '🏆' if Lagos (or any African city) trained you for success!
